observed: One common hash-bound SRAM firmware produced exact causal phase signatures: unchanged public32 negative 0x04 (no user event; old bit1 hook works), zero-source overlay control 0x00 (same cells/routes/core surgery as production, final user event LUT forced zero; old hook removed), and production 0x01 in three sequential runs (ordinary-Verilog pulse set status; W1C cleared; old hook inert; core reset cleared and did not re-arm user state). Every run had FCB=0x000f0002, all non-status error groups zero, counter seen=0xff, observations=8, final words [0x4147414d,0,0,0], cleanup reset, and no flash command.
status_contract: A user design built through --uarch --internal-ports exports exactly one scalar status_set. The fail-closed compositor preserves the hash-pinned public32 core, removes the exact old qualification hook, shares only the qualified GCLK0/HCLK tree, rejects hard cells, extra ports, incomplete routes, BEL or wire collisions, and routes the already-routed user driver to the retained HCLK-registered W1C set stage. This example emits one HCLK-synchronous pulse after configuration; status retains it until W1C bit0 clears. Core reset does not reset or re-arm arbitrary user state.
controls: The core, overlay, production, zero-control, and raw image hashes are mode-bound. Structural tests reproduce output byte-for-byte and exercise core-hash, exact-hook, port, hard-cell, placement, BEL, route-completeness, wire-collision, and GCLK0-root rejection. Production and zero control differ only in one user LUT INIT; routes and reviewed core edits are identical.
scope: One AGRV2KL48/L48 HSE=8 SYSCLK=10 release mechanism for a separately routed pure-fabric scalar event composed into the exact public32 W1C ingress. Silicon proves the included four-LUT/two-FF HCLK-synchronous example, not every possible user design. This is not placement reservation or a guarantee that an arbitrary overlay fits without core collision, multi-bit status, asynchronous CDC/pulse capture, interrupt wiring, user/core shared reset semantics, other package/device, full-window/burst/misaligned/signed access, or a generic register-bank generator.
consequence: An application no longer has to hand-edit the hash-bound public32 routed JSON to own STATUS_SET: ordinary Verilog can be routed independently, admitted fail-closed, composed deterministically, strictly packed, and rejected without emitting an image if it collides with the qualified core.
next_experiment: Add reservation-aware joint placement or a pre-route core obstacle map so larger overlays avoid reject-after-route churn; keep asynchronous synchronization and multi-bit status ABI separate.
